652:t_1:88.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I've heard about $$キタン$$ too...」

652:t_1:89.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And I doubt you'll ever forget Major $$グラハム$$ either...」

652:t_1:91.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n... Don't get any funny ideas.」

652:t_1:93.en:
$$クロウ$$
「There comes a time when everyone feels they have to do that...」

652:t_1:94.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But until the very last moment, don't give up looking for another way.」

652:t_1:96.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I figured you might be stuck over the whole $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$ティティ$$ business...」

652:t_1:97.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Anyway, I don't want to see a comrade die either... especially one younger than me.」

652:t_1:100.en:
$$葵$$
「This is depressing, though... A $$バアル$$ nest is swarming with things like that, isn't it...」

652:t_1:101.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「The galactic center, the nest of the $$宇宙怪獣$$, and the dimensional rift we saw when we were transferred before, which seems to be the home base of the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s...」

652:t_1:102.en:
$$朔哉$$
「But the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ survey couldn't find the dimensional rift, right?」

652:t_1:103.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Right... Apparently that rift is neither always there nor something that can only occur at a specific location.」

652:t_1:104.en:
$$くらら$$
「So that's why we decided to head for the galactic center first.」

652:t_1:105.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「But when I think about another space monster like that last $$変動重力源$$ showing up...」

652:t_1:106.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I believe that type evolved by somehow taking a gravitational collapse into its body.」

652:t_1:107.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Apparently the gravitational collapse produced when one is shot down can be handled, since Dr. $$トライア$$ developed a system that transfers the surroundings to another dimension, but...」

652:t_1:108.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「If possible, I'd rather not fight something like that.」

652:t_1:109.en:
$$朔哉$$
「I wish we could connect hearts with them the way we did with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

652:t_1:111.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「If we could do that, we wouldn't be struggling.」

652:t_1:112.en:
$$朔哉$$
「W-What! We can even make friends with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ and the $$バジュラ$$, so I just thought we could with them too...!」

652:t_1:113.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Besides... aren't they called $$バアル$$, the natural enemies of humankind, precisely because we can't communicate with them?」

652:t_1:114.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If we could, they probably wouldn't be $$バアル$$ anymore.」

652:t_1:115.en:
$$ノノ$$
「About that... there's something $$ノノ$$ has been wondering about for a long time.」

652:t_1:117.en:
$$マリ$$
「Is it the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s this time? Or $$ミケーネ$$? The army of darkness?」

652:t_1:118.en:
$$チコ$$
「The universe is this huge and it's still full of enemies...! I can't take this!」

652:t_1:119.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Save the complaining for later. Let's go, everyone.」

652:t_1:120.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! With hard work and guts, I'll protect the future of the universe!」

652:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That soul lives on within a body of steel... That is eternity through the fusion of spirit and matter...」

652:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$... Your fight over the name of hero, and your soul-stirring battle with Lord $$ゼウス$$...」

652:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We'll make the $$Ｚチップ$$s worth 100 Z born from that part of our strength...」

652:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that I should be saying such things at a time like this, but the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open for business!」

652:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for our ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion, but I'll give it my all again today... business, business!」

652:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that I should be saying such things at a time like this, but for now we're open for business!」

652:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for our ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion, but I'll give it my all again today... business, business!」

653:t_000:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Now then, who's our opponent today!」

653:t_000:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Whoever it is, I'm not backing down!」

653:t_000:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn right! Every last one of them is an enemy I don't have to hold back against!」

653:t_000:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Given the situation, I'd rather not fight if I can help it, though.」

653:t_000:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「But even if we can share our intent, there are opponents we can't avoid fighting...」

653:t_000:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「So they're beings we can never reconcile with...」

653:t_000:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems that sort has arrived.」

653:t_001:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「Damn $$ミケーネ$$! They never learn!」

653:t_001:1.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「So you've come, Earthlings! But your fate ends here!」

653:t_001:3.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「The hero back from hell...! To think that one would show up!」

653:t_001:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Looks like $$ミケーネ$$ is getting desperate too!」

653:t_001:5.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「I, $$ガラダブラ$$! By order of Lord $$ハーデス$$, I have come here to settle things with you!」

653:t_001:6.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Earthlings! I no longer think of you as immature weaklings! I will face you with all my strength!」

653:t_001:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Now that's something good to hear!」

653:t_001:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So you've finally acknowledged our strength for real!」

653:t_001:9.en:
$$万丈$$
「We have to be careful. Now that there's no trace of complacency or arrogance, we'd best not think of this opponent as the same as our previous enemies.」

653:t_001:10.en:
$$葵$$
「But if we don't get past that one, we can't fight the boss beyond!」

653:t_001:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's settle this, $$ガラダブラ$$! I'll end our bad blood here and now!」

653:t_003:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So you showed up, $$インベーダー#pilot$$s!」

653:t_003:1.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Grr, curse you, $$バアル$$! You mean to intervene in this battle and devour both us and the Earthlings!」

653:t_003:6.en:
$$ノノ$$
「The $$インベーダー#pilot$$s... aren't $$バアル$$, are they?」

653:t_003:7.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「The $$インベーダー#pilot$$s... aren't $$バアル$$, are they?」

653:t_003:8.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「The $$インベーダー#pilot$$s... aren't $$バアル$$, are they?」

653:t_003:9.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Of all the things to say...!」

653:t_003:10.en:
$$ノノ$$
「After all, we can talk to those people, $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$...」

653:t_003:11.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「After all, we can talk to those people, $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$...」
